official_primary_sources.observation: The page requires a nuScenes account; no unauthenticated immutable archive digest was available to this controller.
Dataset acquisition and use are subject to the nuScenes terms and applicable non-commercial license.
The official instructions require account login and terms acceptance, describe multiple archives, and direct users to unpack them into one nuScenes root.

current_evidence_gap.reason: A pathname, inode, release label or local sidecar cannot establish that the thirteen installed table bytes came from the authenticated official distribution.

requested_human_choice.option_a: Approve a later separately authorized, isolated authenticated re-download of the exact official v1.0-trainval metadata archive and byte-for-byte comparison against the existing extracted directory.
requested_human_choice.option_b: Provide an existing original official metadata archive plus its acquisition receipt for an isolated, separately authorized verification.
requested_human_choice.option_c: Decline real nuScenes evidence generation; keep the nuScenes manifest and all downstream execution gates stopped.

record: visible official archive filename and release label
sanitized effective official source URL without credentials, tokens or signatures
UTC acquisition start and completion timestamps
HTTP content length plus ETag and Last-Modified when the official server supplies them
streaming SHA256 and byte count of the downloaded archive

reading or hashing the existing metadata tables, sensor data, maps, CAN data or sealed-test files
creating a real input specification, N0 receipt, registered-file inventory or session manifest
